title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu records family moments for his unborn child, touching Kanmani. Meanwhile, the nurse warns Vennila against sedating Rajasekar as Rajeshwari sends Anbu to work.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi gives a gift to Paraman for delivering the batter. Rishi plans revenge, while the lawyer tells Kalamma her court hopes are low unless Kumaresan withdraws the case.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
episodeTitle: Prabhakaran Sets a Trap for Karna
description: To ensure Karna's arrest, Prabhakaran plots a trap to make him reveal his crime. Acting on his plan, Divya secretly mixes medicine into his food, triggering his confession.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi holds a grudge against Mayandi's family, while Rasathi demands money. Pechi shocks Poongodi by revealing that Mayandi has been secretly supporting them.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi loves her new shoes and taunts Ragavan about it. Later, Thangaraj confronts Revathi and visits Ragavan with a proposal for Shruthi.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: As Gomathi arranges Suganya's bangle ceremony, Raji and Meena remain distant following their conflict. Later, Suganya happily gets ready for the function as guests arrive.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan brings bangles for Nila when Thenmozhi leaves for home. Tension erupts as Thenmozhi exposes them as not being gold and scolds him for deceiving the family.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu's smart safety measures for women impress a corporate company, earning him a business order. Elsewhere, Sakthivel gives Manoj an idea to seize Kanaga's property.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi suspects Karuppu over leaked information and informs both Aishwarya and Rajangam. Later, Neethiman demands his money back from Eshwari due to the false information.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu grows impressed by Arjun's transformation and opens up to Shasha about him. Meanwhile, Kasthuri lovingly prepares food for Karthik and takes care of him.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Arunachalam gifts clothes for the celebration, and Indhira's family cooks a feast. While Shanmugam panics over Abhi's father, Indhira enjoys a tasty lunch.
